record.field:
# 1. Identify lines to move lines_to_move = record.invoice_line_ids.filtered(lambda l: l.x_studio_target_company)
if not lines_to_move: raise UserError("Please select a 'Target Company' on the invoice lines first.")
for target_co in lines_to_move.mapped('x_studio_target_company'): co_lines = lines_to_move.filtered(lambda l: l.x_studio_target_company == target_co)
# 2. Find the correct Journal in the Target Company target_journal = env['account.journal'].search([ ('type', '=', 'sale'), ('company_id', '=', target_co.id) ], limit=1)
# 3. NEW: Find Company B's Bank Account (Partner Bank) # This ensures the "Other Info" tab shows Company B's bank, not Company A's target_bank = env['res.partner.bank'].search([ ('company_id', '=', target_co.id) ], limit=1)
new_invoice_lines = [] for line in co_lines: target_account = env['account.account'].with_company(target_co).search([ ('code', '=', line.account_id.code) ], limit=1)
if not target_account: raise UserError(f"Account Code {line.account_id.code} not found in {target_co.name}.")
new_invoice_lines.append((0, 0, { 'product_id': line.product_id.id, 'name': line.name, 'quantity': line.quantity, 'price_unit': line.price_unit, 'account_id': target_account.id, }))
# 4. Create the Invoice with FORCED Company B defaults new_invoice = env['account.move'].with_company(target_co).sudo().create({ 'move_type': 'out_invoice', 'company_id': target_co.id, 'journal_id': target_journal.id, 'partner_id': record.partner_id.id, 'invoice_date': record.invoice_date, 'partner_bank_id': target_bank.id if target_bank else False, # Forces Co B Bank 'invoice_line_ids': new_invoice_lines, })
# 5. Remove lines from the original invoice record.write({'invoice_line_ids': [(2, line.id) for line in co_lines]})
record.message_post(body=f"Split successful! Created {new_invoice.name or 'Draft'} in {target_co.name}")
